summary: Character.kingdom is the zh kingdom NAME from troops.json, and every faction troop (raw KingdomId 3039-3072, 3081/3083/3090/3091, ~5 per kingdom) carries its PARENT kingdom's zh name (e.g. 5 Dripping Caverns 3058 troops = '葛洛什奈克', 5 Shentang faction 3070 troops = '圣唐'; a few more are mis-assigned: 3016 LavaGates-type rows under 破碎尖塔, 3042 under 加尔凡尼亚/剑锋崖/荒芜之地). Native AllyKingdom / SummoningKingdom / CountKingdom steps carry the raw KingdomId, so targetKingdom / kingdomPresent / alliesOfKingdom / randomOfKingdom over-include those troops. Summon pools are fixed per skill in curated (gowKingdomPools.ts, raw ids); the ally/enemy kingdom FILTERS need the raw KingdomId (or faction zh name) on Character and targetKingdom matching by id.
repro: castSpell({key:'weapon:1364', allies:[{kingdom:'圣唐'} /* a raw-3070 faction troop */]}) -> the faction ally receives the random positive status; native RandomPositiveStatusEffect@AllyKingdom Data 3030 excludes KingdomId 3070 troops. Check with node: troops.json kingdom vs data/raw/troops.gow.en.json KingdomId grouped by name.
